profile_text.body:
Khan Academy is a nonprofit organization that operates an online educational platform accessible at khanacademy.org. The site's harvested text returned only a client challenge response, so detail about its programs and mission comes primarily from the held facts rather than scraped content.

Khan Academy offers an AI-powered educational product called Khanmigo, categorized as an Education and Research AI tool. Khanmigo is described as an educational AI tutor, with noted considerations around student interaction data, COPPA compliance, and pedagogical bias, reflecting the particular obligations that come with serving younger learners.

The held facts confirm Khan Academy is a verified nonprofit with no recorded litigation or MCP server presence in this dataset. Its profile was verified as of August 2026.
